name: CC Map
_comment: Insert effect (audio passed through untouched, takes no instrument slot): reads the Launch Control / UC-33 directly over ALSA, maps every knob, fader and pad (learn, 4 pages, 128 slots) and sends the result out of its own ALSA ports 'Out A'..'Out D'. vst.json/module.json only feed mpc-vst-plugins' tools/gen_vst.py for params.h + the skin. The plugin is ccmap_vst.cpp, built by this port's own build.sh.
